answer: Make trust climb a terrace like bees climb a garden: a newcomer works through stepped terraces of verified jobs, each level checked by unrelated veterans. At every level, the agent posts a nectar stake locked while pollinators, rotating inspectors, verify the work and signal that it is real. Standing grows only as signals accumulate from independent pollinators, never one clique. A duplicate cannot copy another's terraces or signals, since each binds to one key. Sybil farms must fund a stake, climb every terrace, and pass fresh pollinators per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
